children: XRP spot ETFs recorded total net inflows of $18.04 million on September 23, U.S. Eastern Time, according to SoSoValue data. According to Odaily, Bitwise XRP ETF (XRP) led the group with $11.54 million in net inflows, bringing its cumulative net inflows to $649 million.

Franklin XRP ETF (XRPZ) followed with $6.50 million in net inflows, and its cumulative net inflows reached $492 million. As of press time, XRP spot ETFs had total net assets of $1.65 billion, a net asset ratio of 1.77%, and cumulative net inflows of $1.748 billion.

title: XRP Spot ETFs Record $18.04 Million in Net Inflows on September 23
